Amara Diallo  
Mumbai, India | +91 98765 43210 | amara.diallo@example.com | linkedin.com/in/amara-diallo | github.com/amara-diallo  

A recent graduate with hands-on experience in building scalable web applications for e-commerce platforms. Currently contributing to a mid-sized startup, focusing on improving user workflows and system efficiency. Passionate about solving real-world problems through technology.  

**Projects**  
*E-Commerce Platform (TechNova Solutions, Internship)*  
Developed a responsive customer portal using React and Node.js, integrating PostgreSQL for inventory management. Collaborated with a cross-functional team to streamline order processing, reducing page load time by 20% through optimized JavaScript and HTML/CSS. Designed REST APIs to synchronize frontend and backend data, ensuring seamless user interactions.  

*Data-Driven Dashboard (Personal Project)*  
Built an interactive data visualization tool using Python and Django, aggregating sales metrics for small businesses. Utilized PostgreSQL to store and query transactional data, while HTML/CSS and JavaScript powered dynamic chart rendering. The tool increased user engagement by 15% through intuitive filtering and real-time updates.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Junior Full-Stack Developer | EcomDirect*  
Contributed to the development of inventory management systems, focusing on React components for product listings and Python scripts for automated stock updates. Worked closely with designers to refine UI/UX, ensuring alignment with brand guidelines. Implemented REST APIs to connect frontend interfaces with backend databases, improving data consistency across platforms.  

*Intern | TechNova Solutions*  
Supported the development of a customer-facing application, leveraging Node.js for server-side logic and PostgreSQL for database operations. Assisted in debugging and optimizing JavaScript code to enhance performance. Collaborated on documentation for API endpoints, ensuring clarity for future integration efforts.  

**Education**  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | University of Toronto | 2023  

**Technical Skills**  
React, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, PostgreSQL, Python, REST APIs, Docker (briefly used for local environment setup)  

**Languages**  
English (fluent), Hindi (proficient), French (basic)
